summary: An undergraduate computer science reader who knows asymptotic notation, algorithm analysis and recursion, discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, primes, the Chinese remainder theorem, sets, permutations, binary representation), and first-year linear algebra (matrices, rank, invertibility, subspaces). They know polynomials and complex numbers including roots of unity, and basic multitape Turing machines. They have not met the fast Fourier transform in depth, convolution theory, Gaussian analysis, fixed-point error control, or the research literature on fast multiplication.

known.name: Logarithms and floor/ceiling
known.gloss: Base-2 logarithm lg n and the integer rounding functions used in bit-length and running-time expressions.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers where numbers are identified when they differ by a multiple of the modulus.

known.name: Prime numbers and prime powers
known.gloss: Integers greater than 1 with no proper divisors, their powers, and the notion of pairwise coprime numbers.

known.name: Chinese remainder theorem
known.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, residues modulo each are in bijection with residues modulo their product.

known.name: Roots of unity
known.gloss: Complex numbers z with z^n=1, expressed as e^{2πik/n}.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Writing integers in base 2 and combining bits with exclusive-or.

known.name: Radix (base-b) representation
known.gloss: Writing an integer as a sum of digits times powers of a base.

known.name: Schoolbook multiplication and carries
known.gloss: The quadratic digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm with carries.

known.name: Recursion and recurrences
known.gloss: Algorithms that solve a problem through calls on smaller instances, with cost described by a recurrence.

known.name: Matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Rectangular arrays of numbers representing linear maps, with product, inverse and invertibility.

known.name: Rank of a matrix
known.gloss: The dimension of the span of a matrix's columns.

known.name: Triangular matrices
known.gloss: Square matrices with zero entries above (or below) the diagonal.

known.name: Vector spaces and subspaces
known.gloss: Sets closed under addition and scaling, and their sub-collections and dimension.

known.name: Rational numbers and fields
known.gloss: Number systems with addition, multiplication and division, such as the rationals or integers modulo a prime.

known.name: Permutations
known.gloss: Rearrangements of a finite set of positions.

known.name: Multidimensional arrays
known.gloss: Data indexed by tuples of coordinates, stored linearly on a tape in some order.

known.name: Finite sets and subsets
known.gloss: Basic set operations and counting of subsets.

known.name: Cyclic groups
known.gloss: Integers modulo n under addition, modeling cyclic index wraparound.

known.name: Complex magnitude and conjugate
aliases: absolute value of a complex number
known.gloss: The size |z| of a complex number and its conjugate, used to bound errors.

known.name: Fixed-point and rounding error
known.gloss: Representing reals by integers scaled by a power of two and bounding the error of rounding.

known.name: Gaussian function
known.gloss: The function e^{-x^2} and its rapid decay.

known.name: Time and space on tapes
known.gloss: Cost of Turing-machine computation measured in steps, including sequential scans of tape contents.

known.name: Inequalities and exponent arithmetic
known.gloss: Manipulating powers, exponents less than one, and bounding sums and products.
